title: Design: Mark this line as No Charge window shows the line and the category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new billable work order for the regular customer, not invoiced, with two lines: each with 1.0 h of labor and one stock part with a cost, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow6-02-02-mark-this-line-as-no-charge.png, iwo-happy-31-31-mark-this-line-as-no-charge.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the billable work order.
  2. Click the three-dots menu of the second line.
  3. Click Mark as No Charge.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • A window "Mark this line as No Charge?" opens with the line summary (title, hours, parts, technician, current price).
  • The body reads "The line stays on this work order and shows $0.00 on the invoice. Hours, parts and the story stay; the technician works it like any other line. When the invoice is created, the parts cost of this line posts to the expense account of the category instead of Cost of Parts."
  • The required select Category, and buttons Cancel then "Mark as No Charge".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R2: “Mark as No Charge opens the dialog "Mark this line as No Charge?" with the line summary (title, hours, parts, technician, current price), the body "The line stays on this work order and shows $0.00 on the invoice. Hours, parts and the story stay; the technician works it like any other line. When the invoice is created, the parts cost of this line posts to the expense account of the category instead of Cost of Parts.", the required select Category (active No Charge categories, "Pick a category" when missing), the selects Original work order and Original line when the category requires it (optional here; helper and the "Original technician: [names]" line as in S2-R2, with "required before the invoice is created"), and the buttons Cancel and "Mark as No Charge".”
